svg.title: JDBC Redisson Read-Through Flow
svg.desc: Sequence diagram rebuilt from exposed-jdbc-redisson README, JdbcRedissonRepository, AbstractJdbcRedissonRepository, EntityMapLoader, ExposedEntityMapLoader, and read-through scenario tests.
svg.text: A cache miss delegates from Redisson RMapCache or RLocalCachedMap to EntityMapLoader, which opens an Exposed JDBC transaction and loads the row.

g.text: READ_ONLY uses a Redisson loader: Redis hits return immediately, misses call Exposed, and loaded rows are cached.
Default invalidation removes cache entries only; database rows stay untouched unless deleteFromDBOnInvalidate is enabled.
